NDT software in Norfolk: inspection work on the Hampton Roads waterfront

Norfolk NDT work is ship work first. Naval Station Norfolk is the largest naval base in the world, Norfolk Naval Shipyard sits across the Elizabeth River in Portsmouth, and Newport News Shipbuilding builds the Navy's aircraft carriers and a share of its submarines up the harbour. Between them runs a dense private ship-repair industry: BAE Systems Norfolk Ship Repair, General Dynamics NASSCO-Norfolk, Colonna's Shipyard, Marine Hydraulics International and a long list of smaller yards and subcontractors working surface-ship availabilities. Add the Port of Virginia's container terminals, the Norfolk Southern coal pier at Lambert's Point, Dominion Energy's Surry Power Station across the James, and the Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project staging monopiles and transition pieces through Portsmouth Marine Terminal, and you have a market where marine, defence and heavy-fabrication inspection overlap every week.

The typical Norfolk NDT contractor supports the repair yards and prime contractors on Navy availabilities, with technicians qualified to Navy technical requirements, and also takes commercial vessel work under classification society rules, pier and crane structural inspection, and fabrication work for offshore wind and port infrastructure. The authorities shaping the paperwork are familiar: NAVSEA technical publications and Navy acceptance standards for ship work, oversight from the regional maintenance centre and supervisors of shipbuilding, classification societies such as ABS, DNV and Lloyd's Register on commercial hulls, and the Virginia Department of Health's Office of Radiological Health, which licenses industrial radiography because Virginia is an NRC Agreement State.

Navy and class work punish missing paperwork. An inspection that was done correctly but cannot show the technician's current qualification, a current vision test and a calibrated instrument is an inspection that gets repeated. The sections below apply each Atlantis ERP module to that reality.

ERP for NDT companies in Norfolk: the short answer

An ERP for NDT companies in Norfolk is one system where technician qualifications, vision tests, instrument calibration, procedures, crew dispatch, inspection reports and invoicing all connect. The Atlantis ERP solution is built for NDT and inspection companies and is implemented and supported by Atlantis NDT, founded by an ASNT NDT Level III.

For waterfront work the value is in the cross-checks. A timesheet warns when a technician's certificate is not valid. A team assignment warns when the UT set or yoke on it is out of calibration. A report cannot move from review to approved without the right signatures, and it carries work order, contract, drawing, WPS, procedure and standard references. When a ship's availability schedule shifts overnight, which it does, the dispatcher can re-plan crews without losing that chain of evidence.

Technician certification tracking software for Navy and class work

Technician certification tracking in the Atlantis ERP stores each certification with scheme, level, method, certifying body, industry sector, issue, expiry and renewal dates, OJT and training hours, exam results and attachments. Status is computed automatically as active, expiring soon (within 90 days), expired or revoked, with warning tasks and daily email alerts.

Norfolk technicians often carry more than one qualification for the same method: an SNT-TC-1A certification under the company's written practice, a Navy-specific qualification for ship work and sometimes client-specific approvals. Scheme options include SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP and 'other', so Navy qualifications are recorded under 'other' with their own certifying body, dates and documents, next to the rest. Nothing has to live in a separate binder.

Vision examinations are where waterfront audits most often find gaps. The vision-test record holds Jaeger J1/J2 near vision, far vision, colour perception and contrast, the examiner, clinic, certificate file and expiry, and triggers the same 90-day warning as a certificate. The employee NDT profile shows highest level, methods certified, radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry. Company certifications, such as quality-system certificates and customer approvals, are held with their own alert days so the company's credentials do not lapse between contracts. See the Certificates app.

Calibration management software for instruments living in salt air

Calibration management tracks every flaw detector, thickness gauge, yoke, probe, survey meter and source-related item by serial number with calibration frequency, status, next due date and lifecycle (new, active, in calibration, in repair, rented out, retired, disposed). The calibration certificate register records provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag with accreditation number, pass/fail/conditional result and the PDF, with expiry alerts.

Salt air, bilge conditions and repeated trips up and down brows are hard on kit. The maintenance log records preventive, corrective, repair, cleaning, firmware update and probe replacement events with condition before and after. Issue and return has supervisor and manager approval and records condition both ways, so a UT cable damaged inside a tank shows up against the right job. Reservations with clash prevention stop two crews claiming the same PAUT unit for overlapping ship checks, and inbound and outbound movements are logged.

The Purchase app supports calibration-lab vendors with an accredited-lab flag, accreditation number and expiry, and order lines linked to a specific equipment serial, so when a ship-repair customer asks for evidence that the lab was accredited on the calibration date, you can pull it in minutes. Consumables such as penetrant, developer, MT baths, couplant and PPE carry reorder levels and low-stock flags. More on the Asset Management app.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for ship availabilities

Crew dispatch runs through Team Assignments: planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, with site GPS coordinates, mobilisation and demobilisation dates, and calendar, kanban and list views. Technicians and equipment serial numbers cannot be double-booked, and out-of-calibration equipment triggers a warning.

Ship availabilities do not run to a neat plan. Tag-outs slip, spaces are not ready, and a crew booked for a pier in Norfolk can end up needed in Portsmouth the same afternoon. The availability calendar (assigned, leave, training, sick, unavailable) blocks overlaps, and each technician shows current assignment, utilisation and next available date. Timesheets record inspection, travel, standby and setup separately, which makes the difference between a standby-heavy week and a productive one visible to both you and the customer.

Base and yard access adds its own layer. Project records carry safety induction and work permit fields next to client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria. If you run radiography, the Fleet app records which vehicles can carry radioactive sources, the transport licence number and expiry, and driver and project assignments with dates and mileage. With hazardous-materials restrictions at the harbour tunnels, knowing which vehicle and which driver are carrying a camera to which site is basic planning. See Team Assignments and Fleet.

NDT reporting software with a marine mode built in

The NDT Reports module covers 17 report types including UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, PAUT, TOFD, MFL, UT thickness, PMI, hardness and holiday/coating testing. Reports go through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent with inspector, reviewer, approver and third-party or authorized inspector signatures.

Marine mode is the feature Norfolk contractors notice first. It adds a vessel cover page with a photo of the ship, inspection location and dates, and the PDF merges the classification-society certificate from a library covering DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, BV, RINA, IRS and ClassNK, plus the inspector's Level II certificate and the instrument calibration certificate. Inspection photos are laid out in a 2-up grid. For commercial vessel work under class, that is the report pack surveyors expect, assembled without copy-and-paste.

For Navy and offshore wind work, method-specific fields do the heavy lifting: UT probe calibration tables, RT source, technique, IQI type and placement, MT technique and particle type, PT method and developer, PAUT focal laws and UT thickness readings by direction. Weld lines record defect type and orientation, and the overall result is acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks. Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML handle customer formats. The offline app keeps working below decks, where there is no signal, and syncs when the technician comes back up. See NDT Reports and Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Procedure control and NCR/CAPA for Norfolk contractors

The procedure register holds document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard, acceptance criteria and body text or file. Workflow runs draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with rejection reasons, locked approved revisions and a full revision history.

Navy and prime-contractor audits ask which revision was used on which job, and the snapshot of each revision answers that directly. The AI-assisted first draft helps when a new customer requires a method-specific procedure you have not written, and a Level III reviews and approves it before use. NCR and CAPA workflows for ship-repair quality findings can be set up during implementation so nonconformances, root cause and corrective actions sit with the jobs they came from. See Procedures.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for ship repair and fabrication

Quotes carry job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products by method and category, a global discount, a branded PDF and online acceptance that converts to a sales order. Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

Repair-yard customers usually want backup to every line. Invoice lines carry cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours, fed by approved timesheets with billable flags and rate multipliers for overtime and weekend work. Field expenses and per diems recorded in Expenses can be re-billed to the job. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices and a 12-month view, which helps when payment terms on subcontracted availability work stretch cash. See Invoicing.

Affordable, customizable ERP for inspection companies in Norfolk

The Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, and pricing is a quote on request. Norfolk contractors typically start with certificates, calibration, dispatch and marine-mode reporting, then add quoting, invoicing and CRM.

The CRM tracks leads by service line, NDT service type, industry sector and estimated technicians and days, with an NDT lead score from 0 to 100. That helps when offshore wind fabrication, port expansion and ship-repair subcontracts all compete for the same crews. The open REST API connects to QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Atlantis also provides ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training and an eLearning portal; Navy-specific qualifications are recorded in the ERP, not trained by Atlantis. Book a demo built around a ship-repair job.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Norfolk

  1. Discovery: review your written practice, customer qualification requirements, report formats and how availability work is dispatched.
  2. Data load: technicians, all qualification schemes, vision tests, instruments, calibration certificates and consumables imported from existing records.
  3. Marine setup: vessel cover pages, class-society certificate library and report templates configured for your customers.
  4. Field rollout: offline app deployed to crews and tested on a live ship check.
  5. Go-live: alerts, approvals, dashboards and invoicing switched on.

Requirements that are not built in are configured during implementation and agreed before work starts. Request an implementation quote.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for ship-repair inspection in Norfolk?

Look for software that combines qualification tracking, calibration, marine-format reports and invoicing. The Atlantis ERP's marine mode produces vessel reports with class, Level II and calibration certificates merged.

Can we record Navy-specific NDT qualifications?

Yes, under the 'other' scheme with certifying body, dates, hours and attachments, alongside SNT-TC-1A certifications.

Does it work below decks without signal?

Yes. The offline app stores drafts and photos locally and syncs later.

Can it track vehicles that carry radiography sources?

Yes. The Fleet app records source-carrying capability, transport licence number and expiry, and project and driver assignments.

Is the Atlantis ERP suitable for small NDT companies?

Yes. Small contractors can start with a few modules and add more as work grows.

How is pricing handled?

By quote on request. Ask for a Norfolk quote.
